arxiv-2512-20698.title: Spinning extremal dyonic black holes in γ = 1 \gamma=1 Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory
arxiv-2512-20698.creator: Jose Luis Blázquez-Salcedo, Carlos Herdeiro, Eugen Radu, Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho, Kunihito Uzawa
arxiv-2512-20698.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jose Luis Blázquez-Salcedo, Carlos Herdeiro, Eugen Radu, Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho, Kunihito Uzawa. We propose a general framework for the study of asymptotically flat spinning dyonic extremal black holes (eBHs) in D = 4 D=4 Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory. Restricting to the stringy value γ = 1 \gamma=1 of the dilaton coupling constant, we report on the existence of a one parameter family of eBHs which are free of pathologies, provided their magnetic and electric charges are equal.
